title: Easy way to see all global shortcuts
line: Pressing Meta+H now shows an overlay listing every global keyboard shortcut, with a search field.
explanation: Plasma had no quick way to look up global shortcuts: the only list is the Shortcuts page in System Settings, where each app or service has to be opened one by one. Plasmashell now registers a "Show Keyboard Shortcuts" global action, Meta+H by default, that toggles a full-screen overlay with a centered card listing every global shortcut that has a key assigned, grouped by component, with a search field over action names, components and keys and a Configure… button that opens the Shortcuts page. The list is read from kglobalaccel over D-Bus each time it opens, so custom shortcuts show up right away; Escape, a click outside or the shortcut again closes it.

commits.message:
shell: add an overlay that lists all global shortcuts

Plasma has a lot of global shortcuts and the only place to look them up
is System Settings. Add a "Show Keyboard Shortcuts" action (Meta+H) that
opens a searchable overlay with every active shortcut, read when shown.

BUG: 500440

media.caption: Patched: Meta+H opens the Keyboard Shortcuts overlay above open windows
Master: the only list is System Settings > Shortcuts, one component at a time
Patched: typing "window" in the overlay filters to every matching shortcut
